sources.method: Trade 5 Uncommon fish for one Uncommon Bag.

RiftCore_Bag_Uncommon.description: Right-click to open. Exactly 4 different raw materials; 3-6 of each. At most one Lesser gem type; 1-2 gems count as one material.

RiftCore_Bait_Bloodfin_Chum.name: Bloodfin Chum
RiftCore_Bait_Bloodfin_Chum.description: Fish move 15% faster and catch progress drains 15% faster when the fish leaves your bar. Catches are 25% larger and award 25% more Fishing XP.

RiftCore_Bait_Dreamcap_Dough.name: Dreamcap Dough
RiftCore_Bait_Dreamcap_Dough.description: Fish move 15% slower and dart 15% less often.

RiftCore_Bait_Gilded_Roe.name: Gilded Roe
RiftCore_Bait_Gilded_Roe.description: Your catch bar becomes 10% smaller. Scarce and Very Rare fish are 25% more likely, and treasure chance increases by 5 percentage points. Mythic fish chances stay the same.

RiftCore_Bait_Mossworm.name: Mossworm Bait
RiftCore_Bait_Mossworm.description: Start each catch with 50% progress instead of 35%.

RiftCore_Bait_Snapgrub_Cluster.name: Snapgrub Cluster
RiftCore_Bait_Snapgrub_Cluster.description: Catch progress fills 20% faster while your bar covers the fish.

RiftCore_Fishing_Rod.name: Fishing Rod
RiftCore_Fishing_Rod.description: Right-click to cast or reel. During a catch, hold right-click, Ability1, or Ability2 to raise the catch bar; release to fall. Use Ability3 (R by default) while idle to open the Fishing Journal.

RiftCore_Gills_Potion.name: Gills Potion
RiftCore_Gills_Potion.description: Lets you breathe underwater for 2 + ([Skill]/15) * 5 minutes.

RiftCore_Jewelcraft_Band_Copper_Amulet.name: Copper Amulet
RiftCore_Jewelcraft_Band_Copper_Amulet.description: An empty copper amulet band. Socket gems at a Jewelcrafting bench.

RiftCore_Jewelcraft_Band_Copper_Ring.name: Copper Ring
RiftCore_Jewelcraft_Band_Copper_Ring.description: An empty copper ring band. Socket gems at a Jewelcrafting bench.

RiftCore_Jewelcraft_Band_Gold_Amulet.name: Gold Amulet
RiftCore_Jewelcraft_Band_Gold_Amulet.description: An empty gold amulet band. Socket gems at a Jewelcrafting bench.

RiftCore_Jewelcraft_Band_Gold_Ring.name: Gold Ring
RiftCore_Jewelcraft_Band_Gold_Ring.description: An empty gold ring band. Socket gems at a Jewelcrafting bench.

RiftCore_Jewelcraft_Band_Silver_Amulet.name: Silver Amulet
RiftCore_Jewelcraft_Band_Silver_Amulet.description: An empty silver amulet band. Socket gems at a Jewelcrafting bench.

RiftCore_Jewelcraft_Band_Silver_Ring.name: Silver Ring
RiftCore_Jewelcraft_Band_Silver_Ring.description: An empty silver ring band. Socket gems at a Jewelcrafting bench.

RiftCore_Luminence_Potion.name: Luminence Potion
RiftCore_Luminence_Potion.description: Illuminates you like torchlight for 5 + ([Skill]/15) * 5 minutes.

RiftCore_Lure_Barbed_Spoon.name: Barbed Spoon
RiftCore_Lure_Barbed_Spoon.description: Select from the Fishing Journal. Grants 0.75 seconds of grace before catch progress drains. Durability: 50.

RiftCore_Lure_Cloudcork_Float.name: Cloudcork Float
RiftCore_Lure_Cloudcork_Float.description: Select from the Fishing Journal. Smoother lift, 15% slower fall, and a 60% softer bottom bounce. Durability: 50.

RiftCore_Lure_Dartcatch_Spinner.name: Dartcatch Spinner
RiftCore_Lure_Dartcatch_Spinner.description: Select from the Fishing Journal. After a dart, your catch bar is 35% larger for 0.8 seconds. Durability: 50.

RiftCore_Lure_Tidebell_Hook.name: Tidebell Hook
RiftCore_Lure_Tidebell_Hook.description: Select from the Fishing Journal. Treasure fills 35% faster, never decays, and the hook window lasts 0.5 seconds longer. Durability: 50.

RiftCore_MealV3__Aubergine.name: Wisdom Party Meal
RiftCore_MealV3__Aubergine.description:
Place on the ground, then press F to take a serving. Party: +30 Wisdom for 15 minutes. One food buff at a time. Replaces your previous meal. Survives death.
Placer's serving: +30 Wisdom. Remains placed for one minute; one serving per party member.
